title: Made a free pixel-art VFX editor with real physics. Runs in a browser tab, scenes are plain JSON
author: sinopsky
selftext:
Free pixel-art VFX studio, runs in a browser tab, no install.

SKILL file and the linter are what made agent-authored effects actually work. render.js serves the app folder, drives whatever headless chrome or edge, write JSON, lint it, render it, score it, all headless.

Every FX is a real sims. Fire burns through wood and leaves ash, ice melts and puts the fire out, blocks fracture into convex pieces that stack and grind, ofc water, lava, dust, and etc. 61 presets, exports PNG, sprite sheets and GIF.

Built with Claude over a couple of months. JSON scenes and the sim is seed-deterministic, so generated effects render the same everywhere.

[https://sinopskyd.itch.io/phosphor](https://sinopskyd.itch.io/phosphor)
